description: A short check for IT service desk staff at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company, taken after the awareness episodes (pair AB). Ten new items from the IT service desk queue, the same kinds as before. It is matched to the first check (awareness_pre_helpdesk_ab), and the end screen compares the two results when the first check was finished.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
